doc.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022

title: Advice for a grandchild wanting to be a musician
summary: Blue says a child must work hard, love music and make the decision themselves.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: I was wondering if they or perhaps they might have a grandchild and, “Grandpa I want to be a professional musician.” What do you think?
What do I think? I would — well I would tell she or he that well you have to work hard and it has to be your decision, you know how you move towards that. You know? And

there’s certain things that you’re going to need to begin to learn to prepare yourself, to build your skills. And the first thing is you really love music. And let them take it from there. And I’ll be supportive of whichever way they go.
